description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven ranged single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] based on entry element damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Fran] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Eight single ranged attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (8s)] to the target, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Instant Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Eight single ranged attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (8s)] to the target, grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Instant Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Fran
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
